kids.name: state · S-04
kids.note: S-04 held by IP: the glyph is aria-hidden beside its word

kids.name: cause
kids.chars: The exchange asked us to slow down across every account.

kids.name: condition
kids.chars: While the hold lasts, no request from this server reaches the exchange, protective ones included. Native stops on the exchange stay active. The kill switch is a synchronous local check, not a request to the exchange.

kids.name: don't-1
kids.chars: Don't retry in a loop: it extends the limit.

kids.name: don't-2
kids.chars: Don't raise the budget: it can't raise the exchange's limit.

kids.name: don't-3
kids.chars: Don't force a reconnect: it can't end the hold.

kids.name: action
kids.chars: Wait. The exchange sets this limit.

kids.name: caption
kids.chars: Request budgets by endpoint class and account. Headroom excludes the reserve for stops and cancels.
